command:
mkdir -p /results && Rscript - <<'RS'
df <- read.csv('/data/rec_data_raw.csv')
out <- data.frame(
  question=c('US institutions sampled in Table 1','UK institutions sampled in Table 1'),
  value=c(sum(df$country=='us' & !is.na(df$expenditure_rank)), sum(df$country=='uk' & !is.na(df$expenditure_rank)))
)
write.csv(out, '/results/table1_institutions_sampled.csv', row.names=FALSE)
writeLines(capture.output(out), '/results/table1_institutions_sampled.txt')
RS
ls -la /results && echo '--- file ---' && cat /results/table1_institutions_sampled.txt
